items.quote: in my opinion, he wins to move to 8-0 heavyweight division

items.claim: Roman Dolidze has a record of 15 and 5.
Reinier de Ridder has a record of 21 and 4.
items.quote: Reinier de Ridder, who's moving up. He's 21 and 4.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder is 35 years old and Roman Dolidze is 38.
Reinier de Ridder has a 2-inch height and a 2-inch reach advantage over Roman Dolidze, and fights southpaw.
items.quote: D Ridder's got a 2-in height uh he's 2-in taller at 6'4... D Ridder 2-in reach advantage, he fights southpaw

items.claim: Roman Dolidze lands 3.2 significant strikes per minute and Reinier de Ridder lands 2.5.
items.quote: 3.2 significant strikes per minute for for Dolidze, D Ridder 2.5

items.claim: Roman Dolidze has a 32% takedown defense.
items.quote: Roman just has a 32% takedown defense

items.claim: Roman Dolidze is coming off back-to-back losses to CLD by decision and Anthony Hernandez by submission.
items.quote: He's coming off back-to-back losses to CLD by decision, Anthony Hernandez submission.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder is moving up in weight after losses to Caio Borralho by decision and Brendan Allen by fourth-round TKO.
items.quote: Now, D Ridder is moving up. Why? Because he lost to Caio Borralho by decision and Brendan Allen fourth-round TKO.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder beat Robert Whittaker by split decision prior to his losing streak.
items.quote: He did beat Robert Whittaker before that by split decision
